items.description: The SEO Audit tool from SEO Review Tools, utilizes the power of Ahrefs, SEMrush and MOZ to present you with a full website SEO audit in just 15 seconds. Data returned by this tool include: Domain Authority, Page Authority, Search volume and Backlink count. After entering your URL, this tool will analyse your website based on 21 different data points.

The Backlink Checker gives you access to the backlink profile of your website and that of your competitors. When you submit an URL you can choose to view the complete backlink profile for a website or you can select to view the backlinks pointing at a specific webpage. Other metrics returned by the backlink checker include: Ahrefs Domain rating, Anchor text, Referring Domains and Referring IPs.
QuickBlox MapChat is a simple plugin for WordPress, that adds a MapChat (chat integrated with map) widget to your website. You can chat over a map or in chat room.
A place for auto enthusiasts to show off their rides. Check out cars and motorcycles from around the world.
App building options is a list of 6 common options for building apps on mydigitalstructure.

InDash allows you to manage and process your incoming text messages. It lets you quickly setup a dashboard for your Nexmo incoming numbers. You can configure SMS forwards to email / URLs or setup keyword-based auto-responders.
Simply text #selection to see it appearing on the web page in real time!
Call or Text a Question to (312) 698-3678 and get an answer. Uses Twilio and Twilio SMS APIs.
Map of March 2008 protests in Tibet, and ensuing events. With photos, summaries, and links to supporting documentation about the Tibetan Centre for Human Rights and Democracy, TCHRD, website.

One key part missing from del.icio.us is a full-text search API. Delicious Search Exploder uses Yahoo Query Language, Pipes, and a couple of native feeds from Delicious to provide an on-page search-and-browse experience for users, tags, and sites.
Turns your Java-enabled mobile phone or your PDA mobile phone running Windows into a personal real-time tracking solution.

connectme.cc is a quick and easy way to share your contact information with anyone on the go. Send one text message with your email, phone number or Twitter username and connectme.cc will automagically deliver a message to them with your business card. This solution does not require you to share the same device, application or social network to connect.

Loqly is a platform to discover places around you and ask/answer questions about local businesses. With Loqly, users can ask for business recommendations or search for a business and ask specific questions. The questions are directed to locals in the area and users get answers in real time.
Google Maps mashup of community submitted hotel prices.
Search for golf videos, tutorials and golf courses, with each mapped.
0Boxer is an email plugin for Gmail. Makes a game out of your email and rewards you for reaching and maintaining inbox zero.
A Google Gadget with a daily quote about first-time events recorded in sports, music, television, movies, politics, nature, history, fashion, fads, literature, science, and more.

The app features the latest bitcoin news and analysis, Bitcoin Price Index, a price chart, currency converter and price alert notifications. Users can check the real-time bitcoin price on the app’s homepage which combines price and network pages from the website. Users have the option to toggle between the bitcoin price and network statistics. Currently, the homepage features the USD price index, but users can take advantage of the currency calculator tab to view the price in their currency of choice. The bitcoin price is based on Bitcoin Price Index data.
Find and rate the best Bloody Mary in your neighborhood.
Mapping based search to find German holiday rentals. Compare to find by location, like nearest one to the beach.
Online shopping based on Amazon eCommerce. Written as a hybrid of PHP and Perl. Stores data in flat files. More then 60,000 products in over 60 categories.

Explore travellr is a mashup that searches content from Flickr, Google Maps, and YouTube, and displays useful posts filtered by city, state, or activity. Type New York City and see what comes up, or maybe try searching for skiing in japan.

The Abios Desktop Stream Viewer Mashup is a Qt5 application that uses streamlink and libVLC callbacks to play live video streams. It allows users to access streamlink API’s stream data and libVLC API’s full coverage.
Convert lists into maps, and annotations, and share or export maps in a variety of formats.
Find your Land-Kitespot and other Kiters. Ability to draw Kitespots and upload images.
Displays Amtrak rail routes and stations on Google Maps.
The most fun way to pick a restaurant near you. Enter your zip, enter a cuisine, and let the Wheel of Food determine where to eat today. Inspired mashup.
This Google Maps transit mashup takes an independent ride-guide for the San Diego Trolley and mashes it up with Google Maps.

SoundsGud is an entertainment and advertising company that creates content for Mobile Operators, Vendors, CRBT Promoters, and more. SoundsGud focuses mostly on sound conversion, to attract their clients customers with advertisement.
eatbytweet is a restaurant Tweets mashup covering thousands of restaurants across the US. Use eatbytweet to view up-to-the minute restaurant specials and reservation information.
The eMiniMall advertising banners are built on top of the shopping.com APIs.

The Twitter Instant Speed Meter. TweeSpeed is a web service giving you the number of tweets sent in the last minute. TweeSpeed is based on the public timeline, grab information for the 5 last minutes and calculate an average speed for one minute.
A local social network designed to find other local people who share your interests. Organize local activities and get local advice. It uses Google Maps to show where members live.

Boom cellar is a web application for investors investing in publicly traded vineyards. Boom Cellar lists all the publicly listed vineyards into one easy to use analytics tool. This application uses the HighStock API service.

Enterprisingly supports entrepreneurs with the unique combination of key services and a strong online community. Instead of searching endlessly for partners or deciding between different service providers, Enterprisingly offers a one-stop shop where a startup can be efficiently built in a record time.

A real estate site that gives you quick and easy access to information on any property in the US. eppraisal.com data is updated daily and pulls from a database of about 70 million homes. Integrated maps and estimated home valuations.
Combination of Mediawiki and Google Maps to manage location based data about Dutch cultural heritage.

Search sports teams and stadiums from around the world. View sports stadiums on satellite imagery. Get directions to sports teams and stadiums, and plot your route on Google Maps. Leagues listed include NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS, and many more.
Mashup to get nformation about your local events. Uses Eventful and Google Maps.
Instant map search for local weather and nearest hotels, foods, bars, parking, clinics etc.
AirportHotels.com is a free hotel comparison service for hotels near 28 UK airports including Heathrow, Stansted, Gatwick, Manchester Airport and more. Integrates with the sletoh.com API.
Ditto is a location iPhone app that lets users get recommendations about restaurants, movies and things to do.
UK interactive guide of pubs that serve real ale. Features reviews, visits, photos, and a forum.
A fun way to explore Flickr images based on your own taste. Select a couple of images you like and instantly get recommendations, based on like-minded people.
kakao2 is an interactive weather map that allows users to view cloud cover and weather updates by manipulating a map of Asia.
What will my utility bill be after solar? Does solar make sense for me? Enter your zip code and find out!
A mashup of the Most Livable States of America based on Livablity Rating, which is the average of state rankings in 44 different factors.
Reptiles, lizards and snakes for sale. Classified ads for all kinds of reptiles and amphibians
todoTweet takes all the tweets from your twitter account with #todo and creates a clean and easy to use to-do list.
A place for lunch friends to create groups, add their favorite restaurants to their groups and then vote on where to go out for lunch.
Use Speak for Me to make a phone call right from your browser and type what you want to say in English, German, French and Spanish.
Your grocery list as mashup. Use a barcode scanner and this service to keep track of your running grocery list. Uses data from the UPC Database web service.
Whenever you check in with Foursquare and you're near a transit stop, 4sqtransit will send back a text message with realtime schedule information for that location.
A local restaurant guide providing restaurant ratings, restaurant reviews, restaurant coupons, maps and a huge directory.
Google map of the journey of Abass Hassans from Somalia Refugee Camps in Kenya to Princeton University.
Powerfully motivating facts, tips and encouragement to help you quit smoking. Delivered to you fresh daily by voice, email and text.

Frame an ecard using this web tool using photos from your own computer, from a remote site using a web address or from your Flickr account. Then send it via email as an ecard or save it to your Flickr account.
Game that keeps track of Twitter users twooshes and ranks them accordingly. Tracks the length of your tweets, and the closer to a 140 character average, the better your score.
Honeygain is a mobile application in which users can earn money by allowing application access to user behavior. Simply download the app, turn it on, and earn!
Code It allows users to write code without leaving their Firefox OS phone. The aplication uses the HackerEarth API to help with enabling coding capabilities.

Mashing up Twilio and Freshbooks to make time tracking easier. You call into a Twilio phone number, and it asks you which client you want to begin billing. When you're all done with your work, you call back and clock out. Your hours are then submitted directly to your FreshBooks account, including a transcription of an optional voice note.
Google Maps holiday trivia map showing cities and towns in USA: named Turkey, or that claim to be the turkey capital of the US or world, or are named Plymouth, or are named Cranberry.
Like an iPhone met Facebook. Real time status updates of your Facebook friends. Update your status, poke and message your friends via advanced UI.
Google map mashup with cards from the World of Warcraft card game. Browse around the screen, zoom in, and explore all the Heroes of Azeroth cards.

One Hash CRM is the easiest and most economical software in the world with its considerably flexible and customer-friendly operation. To help our customers in long-term membership and strengthen cooperation and communication, OneHash relies on combined state-of-the-art development and direct customer knowledge.
Explore UK radio and television. Extensive search options. Uses data from BBC Backstage. Data available in multiple formats: RSS, iCal, JSON.

SDMX-SAX Faces brings together multiple free SDMX (Statistical Data and Metadata eXchange) data services in one data portal. One of these data services is OECD, which is integrated via the OECD Open Data API.
Plays videos nonstop based on your search query. Uses the VHX API.
Twitter cartoons. Each cartoon's text is populated by tweets on each subject. Browse through the selection of cartoons in the menu.
Worldwide vacation rental listings direct from owners.
DVDCrate: The online DVD cataloger and organizer. Track your viewings, share with friends, keep with with disc loans, manage your collection. Much more!
Map of the home towns of US female casualties of the Iraq War.
Talk to cute waifu on Desktop (Windows/Mac/Linux). Waifus are anime-themed personal assistants.
BART station maps, schedules, timetables, and other details in a convenient Google Map
App lets you add random jokes to your Facebook Profile. Jokes come from a Google API-based site.
This mashup allows Box.net users to send faxes of documents stored in their Box accounts using eFax.
The Social Local Web Scan Plugin for your website.
Mp32tube allows YouTube users to easily upload mp3s on youtube.com, as YouTube does not allow this feature.

Agent locator using the ST_INTERSECTS statement of Google Fusion Tables. The Application shows the location of estate agents that speak english located in france. It displays this information on a map with a radius.

Tools For Etsy is a free service for buyers, sellers and developers built to simplify and enhance the Etsy community experience. Tag Wars, Consolidated Feedback and free advertising are just some of the many tools and resources available.
Shop for a variety of gifts. Uses the Amazon eCommerce API.
Lists recent tweets about Amazon.com products from the Twitter public timeline.

Cordurl is part maps, part tinyurl, and part social network. Every spot on the globe is represented by a 7-digit geocode. You can subscribe to a geocode to meet your neighbors, find out what's happening in places where you spend time, and share info.
An interactive map that displays news for the specific country you click on. A Google Maps, Google News, and Geonames.org mashup.
Moonotes stores web finds, and see what others are bookmarking. Enjoy and comment. It utilizes Facebook API.
Guide for businesses and service providers in Switzerland with community integration.
Blizzalert makes it so you never a miss a great day on the mountain. You select which ski areas you want to watch and Blizzalert will send text message alerts when storms are coming through.
This service uses Google Street View and the Instagram API to give context to Instagram posts.
iLoveInns is a Bed and Breakfast locator. Search by location or by a region to drill down. It also has gift certificates, a shopping cart, my favorites and other features.
Simple Amazon search interface that filters items to show only things eligible for Amazon Prime free shipping.

Poll Position is a software application designed for Google Glass. It is not endorsed, or made by Google, but it consumes Google APIs. With Poll Position, users can implement Google's Civic Information API in order to retrieve polling information available on a per state basis.
Fast Criminal Records provides the most complete online criminal records on anyone you know - instant, anonymous & accurate.

The internet magazine via-ferrata.de has created a wide selection of some of the most beautiful Klettersteige, vie ferrate, in the Alps. Brand new is the selection of regions and vie ferrate by using Google Maps.
Enter your zip code to find Social Security offices nearest you.
Experimental navigation tool for exploring the space of related Flickr tags. Type in one start tag and dive into tag space. Requires Flash 8.
Uses the yolink search API to return expanded keyword search information from the government’s PubMed medical database, allowing quick review for relevant information.
Get maps and information about your favorite stars, plus view maps. Get star, planetarium, and observatory information.
Agenteimovel.com.br is a Brazilian real estate website offering sale and rental listings as well as property statistics and trends.
Forums connected to a map. Mark a place and then type a question. In other words create an initiation for a discussion and get a unique link for the map.

Salonist software is a smart tool for handling salon services and activities. With the help of this tool, salon owners can earn more profits and also can streamline their business operations. Its inventory management feature helps to manage the inventory of the salon products.
The Longest Poem in the World is composed by aggregating real-time public Twitter updates and selecting those that rhyme. Created as a social experiment, the poem is growing at ~4000 verses/day.
South America-related maps. Sophisticated map search.
Provides a list of videos, pictures, maps, and wikipedia information for Forbes traveler's list of top 50 locations.
Content based visual image search application for Flickr. Look for an image you like, then Find Similar photos either by subject matter mode or color and texture mode.
Zeiss European store finder for Germany.
Où sortir à Paris ? is a mobile application, designed for users in Paris, France. This application lets users find information about local events in Paris.
Online aromatherapy shop created using Shopping API. Price comparison with direct product links to stores. Aromtherapy.eu has subdomains for US, DE, FR, and AU. Main domain used for UK Shopping API.

American Directions Group is an online company that provides outreach services to the private and public sectors; specializing in survey market research. Some of the research methods used include phone interviewing, political polling, advertising-message testing, studies of public policies, and more.

Welly is a mobile application that provides users their very own companion creature that travels with them and tracks their steps with the Fitbit activity monitor. It is an interactive activity game that makes workout simple and fun.
Passione non profit is an Italian site. It appears to be an aggregate of non profit blog posts.

BeeLiked, is a new social media marketing tool built specifically to help you maximise engagement with BeeLiked campaign features, and then manage and promote your contest with our social dashboard. The platform enables you to launch a Twitter contest within minutes, manage and moderate entries with minimal hassle, and then pick winners ethically and quickly.
A nicely designed, comprehensive real estate mashup that incorporates Virtual Earth to find, sell, or buy properties.
Advanced search tool for YouTube videos using Google Maps. Query results by category, upload date, time, city and keyword.
Mashup of Google Map and Instagram that displays Instagram photos based on location. The default is set at the current location and the photos are displayed in a flip board style.
CNN Money list of the top 10 most expensive colleges in the United States. Not necessarily the ones you would expect.
Select any section of a webpage in Firefox and find related scientific and research papers. A resource for any scientist, literary writer or researcher in any field.
Helps image buyers more efficiently find images and image owners to sell them, by accepting payments for them and archiving licenses for public inspection.
MusicNectar is a mashup of lastfm, and youtube. The aim of MusicNectar is to make listening to youtube music videos easier, and more informative.

Tweaker the Tweet Speaker will speak tweets to you from the global Twitter stream. Listen to tweets as they arrive in six categories from and about some of the most popular users and topics on twitter. Stop reading tweets, and start listening instead.
Flymore is an online booking company that provides customers access to different travel-related offers and deals. Some of these services include booking flights, hotel reservations, and car rentals.
This is an independent website providing online tracking of EMS China shipments, with maps to help you locate the shipment.

Give1Get2 is an online trading platform based on win-win-win strategy. Users can do online payment and receive money with the Payment Service Provider (Moneybookers API). The PSP is regulated by the Financial Services Authority (FSA) of the UK.
Online tool to create non linear narratives. Integrates the YouTube API.
A mashup like housingmaps.com. It shows the latest flats for sale or rental in Singapore on Google maps.
Enter your search terms and then see 50 thumbnails of videos. Hover over one for a description and click it to play the video. Also lists web, news, blog, image, and book search results.
CallMom provides a channel for buyers and brands to interact, allowing brands to capture customer feedback while they are shopping.
Comic strip related art in Brussels, Belgium. Includes Tin Tin.

A PowerPoint mixer to select a PowerPoint presentation on the fly from SlideShare. It uses the SlideShare.net API and pretty effects by script.aculo.us and prototype.js to select a random slideshow for a given tag.
Excellent visualization of current daylight and nighttime regions around the world. Use the Options bar on the right to tune the settings.
Displays a real-time photo stream from Twitter on a Google map.

How smart are your Twitter friends? This mashup grabs a dozen of the user's most recent tweets and then submits them to OpenAmplify for analysis. Results are shown in numerical and graphical forms. It uses the QueryPath PHP library.
Notify is a note-taking application for the iPad, and through its integration with Box.net, users can upload their notes directly to a Box account.
Great for runners, hikers, bicyclist and anyone else interested in how far they ran, walked, biked, or traveled. Map, save, find, and share your routes.
Spilt screen with half OS OpenSpace API and half Google Maps API.

Cash4Books has for years been enabling its customers to allocate a portion of the cash they receive for their books in support of classroom projects. By plugging into our API's transactional functionality, Cash4Books customers now receive a DonorsChoose.org gift card for the precise denomination of their donation and can hand-pick the classroom project themselves!
Online DNS lookup: remote DNS lookup (nslookup/dig) a host or domain from 30+ locations worldwide.

Whapl is a mobile application that allows users to locate and share their locations with their friends. By using this application, individuals can determine locations (both theirs and their friends) to expedite the process of finding the appropriate places for meetups and social networking.
A SoundCloud user browser that displays relations and connections between users. Will also play their most popular track. It's a ActionScript 3.0 project with source code available.
An example of how to integrate the Twitter Streaming API, Pusher and Pusher WebHooks. More info at http://blog.pusher.com/2011/12/7/filtrand-a-demo-webhooks
Click to call feature for luxury automobile dealership Benzel-Busch; sms marketing and service appointment scheduling.
ErrorStack.com is a new online service designed to help developers manage and analyze their error data.
Docklands Station in Dublin. This map with contours that represent the 3-minute walking time bands from the new station.
Mashes up MLS home listings with bank-owned property records to flag active listings as bank-owned. Allows the bargain-hunter buyer to identify homes for sale owned by a bank.
Displays geographic location of a Domain or IP address on Google Maps.
A site that aims to make it easier to decide what movies you can watch with your friends.
LaalBus is an online booking company for buses covering all regions of India. Customers will be able to find and book bus tickets for their travel needs.

Starbucks customers who use the free Wi-Fi at more than 6,800 U.S. company-operated stores are greeted with the Starbucks Digital Network (SDN), an exclusive content network curated by the company and designed to enhance the customerâ€™s in-store experience. DonorsChoose.org is prominently featured in the My Neighborhood section of the SDN. When Starbucks customers click the DonorsChoose.org tile in the SDN, our API's projects near me functionality shows the customer the closest classroom projects to their location!
